messages.subject: Interpretation of Results
parts:
Code
formula <- y ~ 0 + b0 + elevation + slope + NDVI + rodentdensity + f(s, model = spde)
# inla() call
res <- inla(formula,
            family = "binomial", Ntrials = numtrials,
            control.family = list(link = "logit"),
            data = inla.stack.data(stk.full),
            control.predictor = list(
              compute = TRUE, link = 1,
              A = inla.stack.A(stk.full)
            )
)
summary(res)

Results
